findings.text: A public boot service ensures the A20 address line is usable before later boot stages continue. It takes no arguments and reports outcome as zero for usable and negative for still wrapped after all attempts.

Enabling uses a bounded retry cycle that verifies and attempts in turn. Each cycle probes with a short check, tries firmware assistance with another short check, tries controller assistance with handling for delayed effect plus a long check, then tries fast port control with a long check, stopping early on success and failing only after the retry budget ends.

The probe exploits a one megabyte alias between two segment bases. It preserves the original word, writes an incrementing pattern through one view, reads through the other view with a small offset, restores the original, and treats any difference as proof the line is enabled.

Probe offset is five hundred twelve. Short verification uses thirty two iterations. Long verification uses two million iterations equal to two raised to twenty one. Outer enable budget is two hundred fifty five cycles.
Controller draining permits up to one hundred thousand polls. Up to thirty two all ones status reads are tolerated before treating hardware as absent.

Controller status is at port 0x64 with data at 0x60. Timing delay writes zero to 0x80. Fast control is at 0x92. Controller sequencing uses 0xD1 invitation followed by 0xDF payload and 0xFF trailing null. Low status bits separate input presence from controller readiness.

Draining discards pending input while inserting delay between polls and finishes once both directions look idle. Repeated all ones status beyond tolerance signals missing hardware. Behavior is bounded and distinguishes idle from timeout or absence.
Fast gate update must enable the gate bit while keeping the reset bit clear. Setting reset would reboot the machine rather than enable addressing.

Real mode access helpers provide selector setters and getters plus sized loads, stores and block compares through FS and GS views. Widths include byte, word and double word with offsets expressed in an unsigned address type.
Same named helpers exist in two forms. Early boot drives hardware selectors directly. Compressed stage keeps a software base scaled to bytes and uses plain memory operations through that base.

Firmware register block is a union of three views over shared storage. One view holds full width general registers with combined segment and flag words. Another view splits the same storage into sixteen bit halves exposing segment selectors and flag halves. A third view exposes byte pieces for low register parts. Together they carry general, segment and flag state for firmware calls.
A preparation helper clears a firmware register block, marks carry to catch unsupported firmware calls, and copies current data, extra and FS and GS selectors from the running context.

A power firmware probe negotiates a thirty two bit connection and stores connection descriptors into boot parameters. It returns zero for usable connection and negative when firmware is missing or negotiation fails.

Negotiation starts with installation verification including signature and capability checks, continues with a precautionary disconnect, then a thirty two bit connect whose returned selectors and lengths are recorded, followed by a second verification. Failure at verification or connect leads to disconnect and overall failure.

Interaction uses interrupt 0x15 function 0x53. Subfunctions cover recheck, thirty two bit connect and disconnect. Acceptance needs clear carry, letters P and M as signature 0x504D, and capability bit one set.

Bit helpers test and set a numbered bit in memory. Testing chooses a portable mask when the index is known at compile time and a hardware test otherwise. Setting performs a hardware atomic set with memory update.

Early heap is a bump region anchored at image end. Allocation rounds the cursor to requested alignment and advances by size times count. A capacity predicate compares remaining space against a byte need. Reset restores the anchor and no general free exists.

Minimum stack reserve is one thousand twenty four bytes. Array count derives from total size over element size. Relaxation is a processor pause hint. Early addresses use a thirty two bit unsigned type.

Valued search treats the command buffer as whitespace separated words and moves among start, compare, skip and copy behaviors. Copying starts only when the target name is immediately followed by equals. Copied characters respect buffer capacity while total length still counts beyond truncation. Scanning ends at string end or window end and always terminates the output when capacity exists.

Flag search walks whitespace separated words through start, compare and skip behaviors seeking an exact standalone match. It reports a one based position for a match, zero for absence or window exhaustion, and negative when no command pointer was supplied.

Wrappers treat null and high pointers at or above one megabyte as inaccessible. Valid pointers split into selector and offset with selector loaded before scanning. Scans stay within a sixty four kilobyte window from the offset.
Whitespace test accepts any byte at or below ASCII space, thus covering controls and space with a single comparison.

Firmware helpers identify bitness from loader signature, derive system table address from boot parameters with wide high half handling, obtain configuration table location and count in a bitness aware way with kexec override on wide builds, and scan entries for a vendor match.

Root discovery first seeks the newer vendor table identifier and then the older one, yielding zero when neither matches. An outer wrapper checks firmware type and table presence first and halts with fatal diagnostic when firmware was advertised yet tables cannot be located.

On wide builds configuration may come from walking a chain of setup blobs for the EFI kind. A found entry supplies its table pointer. A null table pointer in such entry is ignored with diagnostic and normal lookup continues.
When firmware support is compiled out the same names behave as shims reporting no firmware type, zero system address, lookup failure and zero vendor result, letting callers use legacy paths.

Utility operations include memory fill, bounded lexicographic string compare, binary block compare with defined empty range result, identifier equality through binary compare, and wrapping eight bit additive checksum over a length.
ACPI argument buffer allows ten characters. Immovable reservation array holds twice the maximum node count.

Error handling never returns and parks the processor in a halt loop after messaging. Tables above four gigabytes are inaccessible on narrow builds and force fallback or error. Valued command search truncates output yet counts full length. Heap callers must check capacity before taking memory.

Visible services span address line enabling, power firmware probing, register preparation, valued and flag command lookup, firmware type and table access plus vendor search, warning and fatal diagnostics, and memory, string and checksum utilities.

Diagnostic output exists in verbose and silent builds. Verbose forwards messages to low level output. Silent discards debug messages while error messages remain visible through the error path and warning adds surrounding blank lines.
Boot headers carry guards that keep the boot environment self contained by also blocking the generic kernel bit header, with a similar guard for character handling.
